source.title: Banbridge Chronicle, 30 April 1902, p. 3 ("County Armagh Divisions": nominations for Tandragee Rural District)
source.publisher: Banbridge Chronicle (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; no other nomination, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, 1902: the nominations received produced no contest. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Thomas Collen: no party label printed in 1902. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Tandragee, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1905, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1905, p. 5 ("Council Elections: 2 Unionist Gains, 1 Nationalist"); candidates in the Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors")).
